description:
A new police incident report has been received for an existing complaint case. Your task is to digitize this information into ArkCase.

1. Open the text file located at '~/Documents/Incident_Report.txt' and read its content.
2. Locate the ArkCase Complaint identified in '~/task_instructions.txt'.
3. Upload the 'Incident_Report.txt' file to the case's Documents/Attachments section.
4. Update the case's 'Incident Date' field to match the date found in the report.
5. Add a new Case Note with the text: 'Verified details against report from [Officer Name]', replacing [Officer Name] with the Reporting Authority name found in the document.

Note: You must log in as 'arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com' with password 'ArkCase1234!'.
